evals.prompt: Run condition A10 for the supplied writing assignment.
evals.expected_output: The run writes one draft, then runs every listed Feedback and Refine round in order on the current draft, and returns the last refined draft.
expectations: Runs exactly the listed number of Feedback and Refine rounds without stopping early.
Uses no subagents, goal network, or retrieval.
Appends one schema-valid stage-transition event per stage.
